We are seeking for an experienced Data Engineer to join our team.
 Required skills: 
Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes using Microsoft Azure and Databricks
Build and optimize data lake, Delta Lake, and data warehouse solutions to support reporting, analytics, and AI use cases
Integrate data from multiple enterprise systems using Azure Data Factory, Databricks, APIs, and cloud-native services
Ensure data quality, security, governance, and performance through implementation of engineering best practices and monitoring frameworks
Support advanced analytics and Agentic AI initiatives by preparing, transforming, and delivering trusted data products for business and AI-driven workflows.
 Hybrid work with 3 days in the office in either Bucharest/Timisoara/Cluj/Brasov 
 Why should you join us? 
We have a solid company (projects that last minimum one year), and employees stay with us on average for about 10 years
We have many projects (50+) and lots of career opportunities. After you finish your first project, for the next one you can choose to master the skills that you already know, or learn new technologies on the next one. This way, you do not have to change the company, just the project
Reimbursement of agreed certifications
Private medical subscription
Team buildings.
